title: POST /api/box/live/flatten (200 | 207 | 409)
description: WHAT AN EMERGENCY FLATTEN ACHIEVED, per item. Source: src/box/flattenOutcome.ts buildAttributedFlattenResult(), published by src/box/routes.ts POST /api/box/live/flatten. This route previously answered a hardcoded `ok: true` with HTTP 200 over an untyped `results: unknown[]`, so per-position and per-residual failures were invisible; there was no schema at all. `ok` and the status code are now DERIVED: 200 only on positive evidence that nothing remains, 409 when nothing was reduced and every reason is known, 207 for anything mixed or unproven. CRITICAL: `remaining_quantity` null means UNKNOWN and must never be rendered as zero. `status` is the engine-owned box-status blob (OPEN, validated by box-status.schema.json).

requested.description: How many attributed items the flatten was asked to reduce.

attempted.description: How many of those it actually tried to reduce. Never greater than `requested`; a shortfall withholds `ok`.

operation_id.description: Stable identity for this unit of work, shared by every caller that joined it. Lets a client correlate a retry with the operation it already started — browser abort does not cancel the server operation.

deduplicated.description: True when this request did NOT start a new flatten and instead joined one already running, receiving its real result. No additional broker action was taken.

items.description: One entry per position or crash-only residual group. Always present, even when the item failed.

results.description: Legacy alias of `items`, retained so a client written against the old untyped array still receives one. Additive: the old field name now carries typed entries instead of `unknown`.

settlement.description: What happened BEFORE the reduction was planned: the working-order cancellation sweep and the post-cancellation reconcile.

blocked.description: Non-null when the cancellation sweep was REFUSED outright and nothing was attempted.

outcome.description: The aggregate disposition. Pessimistic: one unresolved item makes the whole result unresolved.

ok.description: TRUE only on positive evidence that nothing remains: every item flat on fill evidence, settlement clean, every requested item accounted for, and no unknown quantity anywhere. Never a literal.

remaining_exposure_known.description: False when ANY item's remaining quantity is unknown. When false, `remaining_quantity` is null and must not be displayed as a number.

remaining_quantity.description: Total quantity still outstanding, or NULL when it cannot be totalled because something is unknown. Null is NOT zero.

blockers.description: Every distinct reason exposure remains or is unproven, including per-item reasons, settlement failures and unattempted items. Deduplicated.

next_action.description: The concrete instruction for the operator. Never empty and never 'nothing' — asserted behaviourally in tests/invariants/flattenOutcome.test.mjs rather than with minLength, which the dependency-free validator and the frontend type generator both deliberately refuse.

status.description: The engine-owned box-status projection, as every mutating Box route returns. OPEN here; validated in full by box-status.schema.json.
